name: Grip | Grip Cake
description:
Grip Cake delivers a rich, sweet aroma with smooth vanilla and cookie flavors, finished with a subtle spicy kick. This strain is known for its calming effects and appetite stimulation, making it a great option for those managing anxiety, depression, fibromyalgia, MS, and related conditions. A soothing experience from start to finish.
